chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام,

He said: I heard him saying: “ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab gathered the companions of the Prophet عليه السلام, and among them was ʿAli عليه السلام, and he said: ‘What do you say regarding wiping over the khuffs?’ Al-Mughirah ibn Shuʿbah stood and said: ‘I saw the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم wiping over the khuffs.’ So ʿAli عليه السلام said: ‘Before al-Ma’idah or after it?’ He said: ‘I do not know.’ So ʿAli عليه السلام said: ‘The Book preceded the khuffs. Al-Ma’idah was only revealed two or three months before he was taken.’”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, the source of the report
key_terms.الْخُفَّيْنِ: the two leather socks or footwear over which wiping was discussed
key_terms.الْكِتَابُ: the Qur'an, cited as the decisive authority
key_terms.الْمَائِدَةُ: Surat al-Ma’idah, referenced here as the basis for the ruling
key_terms.الْمَسْحِ: wiping in the ritual context of wudu (ablution)
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.زُرَارَةَ: the transmitter Zurarah in the sanad

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about wiping over khuffs in wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith concerns the ruling of wiping over khuffs in wudu (ablution) and presents Imam ʿAli عليه السلام as giving precedence to the Qur'anic ruling. It ties the matter to the revelation of Surat al-Ma’idah, indicating that the Qur'anic command came later and overrides earlier practice reports.
